title: Formal substitution chain rule
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $F,G\in R[[T]]$ with $G(0)=0$ [def-weil-formal-power-series]. Define the formal derivative by $D(\sum_{n\ge0}f_nT^n)=\sum_{n\ge0}(n+1)f_{n+1}T^n$, and define $F\circ G=\sum_{n\ge0}f_nG^n$ coefficientwise. Then $$D(F\circ G)=((DF)\circ G)\,DG.$$
